notes: frozen workload definition; prompts are synthetic token-id sets derived deterministically from prompt ids, so no private user prompts are collected
standard measurement shape: 512 input / 256 output tokens with exact recorded prompt ids and cache conditions
cache labels are explicit: cold-declared, warm, prefix-hit, or cache-uncontrolled; a first run is not automatically a cold-storage run
reference inputs are compared only through the four-way identity in PRD section 20.1 (R0/R1/T0/T1)
draft tokens are never reported as final throughput
